text:
Zoe: VoltEdge PM ping: they plan to meter active sessions (start/stop events) rather than hourly cpu. Need mapping to our usage model and reconciliation plan. Can we review constraints tomorrow 9am? cc @Ben @Claire

Ben: Important differences: session-based -> variable-length units. We'll normalize to compute_unit_minutes (round up to nearest minute). Need to agree on start/stop semantics and late stop events.

voltedge-api: Sample start event: {"device_id":"ve-77","event":"session_start","ts":"2026-04-01T15:03:10Z","firmware":"v2.4.1","session_id":"s-abc123"}
stop event: {"device_id":"ve-77","event":"session_stop","ts":"2026-04-01T15:47:02Z","session_id":"s-abc123"}
They may send stop events delayed (up to 48h) if device offline.

Claire: Adapter rules proposal:
1) require session_id on both start and stop. Reject stop without session_id with 422.
2) when stop arrives, compute duration = ceil((stop_ts - start_ts)/60) minutes. If missing start within 7d, mark as orphan_stop and enqueue for manual review.
3) if a stop arrives earlier than recorded start (clock skew), pick earliest plausible pairing using sequence_number or partner-provided monotonic counter.

Mateo: Billing rules: ledger rows at session_stop with fields partner_id, hashed_device_id, session_id, duration_minutes, firmware_tag, source_batch_id. For streaming billing we prefer to emit provisional ledger rows on stop and mark provisional=true for up to 72h for adjustments.

Zoe: Firmware note: v2.x has a bug that duplicates session_stop once in some cases. VoltEdge will include event_checksum to help dedupe. We'll rely on idempotency key = sha256(device_id + session_id + event_checksum).

Ben: Reconciliation: partner will provide per-session rollups (session_id, start_ts, stop_ts, duration, firmware). We'll compare ledger sessions by session_id and hashed_device prefix. Create alert if unmatched_sessions_pct > 0.5% or absolute > 50 minutes per hour.

FinanceBot: Policy: small adjustments (<10 minutes total per partner-hour) auto-apply. Larger adjustments create FIN ticket and set adjustment_pending on ledger rows.

Claire: API responses: 202 accepted (include processed_sessions_count), 400 malformed, 401 invalid-signature, 409 duplicate(session_id), 422 orphan_stop. Rate-limit VoltEdge to 100 req/s and max payload 2k events.

voltedge-api: We will add event_checksum and sequence_number. We'll sign payloads with X-VE-Signature header and can send daily session rollups signed.

Zoe: Tests to add: duplicate stop dedupe, orphan_stop workflow, delayed-stop within 48h, firmware-variant aggregation, rollup delta alerting.

Ben: Action items: Claire build adapter + idempotency lib (ETA 4d), Mateo update ledger schema + provisional flag (ETA 3d), Finance to add auto-apply threshold (ETA 2d), VoltEdge confirm signed rollup schema (ETA 1d).

Zoe: Great. We'll canary with VoltEdge in staging (5 partners) after PR. Meeting tomorrow 9am stands. Thanks!
